description:
Create a new NKS Kubernetes cluster. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

**G3(KVM) cluster requirements:**
- hypervisorCode: 'KVM' (required)
- clusterType: must contain G003 (e.g., SVR.VNKS.STAND.C004.M016.G003)
- k8sVersion: must use nks.2 suffix (e.g., 1.35.3-nks.2)
- lbPrivateSubnetNo: Private LB subnet number (required — returns 400 without details if missing)
- zoneCode: Required at cluster level when isRegional=false (default). Missing causes 400 without details.
- nodePool.softwareCode: Must use FULL value from ncloud_nks_get_server_images including pipe and image number (e.g., SW.VSVR.OS.LNX64.UBNTU.SVR22.WRKND.G003|23215604)
- nodePool.serverSpecCode: g3 spec code (e.g., c2-g3)
- nodePool.storageSize: 100~2000GB (required)

**G2(XEN) vs G3(KVM) differences:**
- G2: clusterType contains G002, k8sVersion suffix nks.1, hypervisorCode optional
- G3: clusterType contains G003, k8sVersion suffix nks.2, hypervisorCode='KVM' required

addons.description: Add-ons to install together with the cluster

configurationValues.description: Helm values override as a JSON string. Defaults to {}

authType.description: Cluster authentication mode. ⚠️ Once set to API it cannot be changed back

bootstrapAccessEntry.description: Auto-create an IAM access entry for the creating principal (authType=API only)

clusterType.description: Cluster type (e.g., SVR.VNKS.STAND.C004.M016.G003 for G3, SVR.VNKS.STAND.C004.M016.G002 for G2)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating

hypervisorCode.description: Hypervisor code: XEN (default) or KVM. Required as 'KVM' for G3 clusters

k8sVersion.description: Kubernetes version (from ncloud_nks_get_versions). G3/KVM uses nks.2 suffix, G2/XEN uses nks.1 suffix

kmsKeyTag.description: KMS key tag for secret encryption (from the Key Management Service console)

lbPrivateSubnetNo.description: Load balancer private subnet number. Required for G3/KVM clusters (API returns 400 without details if missing)

loginKeyName.description: Login key name for node access

fabricCluster.description: Fabric cluster settings — required for server specs where ncloud_nks_get_server_specs reports isFabricClusterType=true

productCode.description: Product code (XEN/G2 only, not available for G3/KVM)

serverSpecCode.description: Server spec code (KVM/G3 only, e.g., c2-g3. from ncloud_nks_get_server_specs)

softwareCode.description: Server image code — MUST use the FULL value from ncloud_nks_get_server_images including pipe and image number (e.g., SW.VSVR.OS.LNX64.UBNTU.SVR22.WRKND.G003|23215604). Do NOT strip the pipe portion.

storageSize.description: Storage size in GB (KVM/G3 only, 100-2000, required for G3)

subnetNo.description: Subnet number for the node pool

subnetNoList.description: Subnet number list for the node pool

subnetLbNo.description: Load balancer subnet number (legacy single LB subnet field)

subnetNoList.description: Subnet number list for the cluster

zoneCode.description: Zone code (e.g., KR-2). Required when isRegional is false (default). API returns 400 without details if missing for single-zone clusters

name: ncloud_nks_create_cluster
